title: First three-source matched-photoperiod public GPS displacement comparison
study_type: exploratory after source-only roster; observation-conditioned within-individual comparison
estimand: falling-minus-rising branch within-animal mean of log1p(median GPS straight-line speed km/h at night) - log1p(median speed at daylight), paired on same daylength. Not raw night share, instantaneous true activity or location occupancy.
interpretation_ceiling: Each species is represented by one source and site; within-source bootstraps cluster by animal but do not justify species-general or global inference. Data coverage is selective; GPS intervals exclude gaps; movement is a minimum straight-line measure. No temperature, vegetation, humans or lunar mechanism has yet been tested.
privacy: Only grouped source statistics; original trajectories and IDs omitted.
